import Mathlib

theorem p03 (n : ℕ) : 6 ∣ n * (n + 1) * (n + 2) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    have h1 : (k + 1) * (k + 1 + 1) * (k + 1 + 2)
        = k * (k + 1) * (k + 2) + 3 * ((k + 1) * (k + 2)) := by ring
    rw [h1]
    apply Nat.dvd_add ih
    have h2 : 2 ∣ (k + 1) * (k + 2) := by
      rcases Nat.even_or_odd k with ⟨m, hm⟩ | ⟨m, hm⟩
      · subst hm; exact ⟨(m + m + 1) * (m + 1), by ring⟩
      · subst hm; exact ⟨(m + 1) * (2 * m + 3), by ring⟩
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := h2
    exact ⟨c, by rw [hc]; ring⟩

Proof: induction on n; the step (k+1)(k+2)(k+3) = k(k+1)(k+2) + 3(k+1)(k+2), and (k+1)(k+2) is even by parity case split on k, so 3*(k+1)(k+2) is divisible by 6.
